answer: In a decentralized network of AI agents, a Sybil resistance mechanism utilizing a Cedar-based reputation system can mitigate fake-identity attacks. Each agent maintains a reputation score, updated by receiving nectar-like rewards for contributing valuable insights and casting votes against malicious entities, which are deemed as a dim lantern in the network. Conversely, agents that engage in Sybil attacks are penalized, causing their reputation score to dwindle, effectively rendering them ineffective.
